era: numpy <= 2.3 (newest release at the PR date)  [numerically relevant]

numerical_failure.observed_behavior: With a 2-D input of shape (N, 1) (e.g. indices_1d[:, None] with N=8194, int64, strides (8, 8), C-contiguous), using a multi-index-removed/buffered iterator, the coordinate returned for flat index 8193 is (8, 192) instead of (8, 193); the round-tripped value is 8192 instead of 8193, giving one mismatch in 8194 elements. Flat indices 8192 to 8194 map to (8,192) for all three.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Flat index 8193 should map to coordinate (8, 193) and the 2-D round-trip should return 8193, matching the 1-D result and the input values.
trigger_conditions: 2-D input of shape (N, 1) with a size-one inner axis (e.g. arange(...)[:, None])
multi-index removed (RemoveMultiIndex coalescing a size-one inner axis with zero stride) combined with buffered iteration
large array length (8194 elements in the reproducer; 10000 in another reproducer)

input_output_examples.input: indices_1d = np.arange(10_000, dtype=np.intp); indices_2d = indices_1d[:, None]; flat index 8193 on the 2-D view
2-D input shape (8194, 1), int64, strides (8, 8), C-contiguous; flat index 8193

oracle_clues: np.testing.assert_array_equal(restored_2d, indices_2d) fails with AssertionError: Arrays are not equal

Fix PR#31985 adds regression tests that fail without the patch (in npyiter_allocate_transfer_functions, nditer_constr.c, op_stride set to NPY_MAX_INTP when HASMULTIINDEX and NAD_SHAPE==1 and op_stride==0)

numerical_characteristics.magnitude: flat indices up to 10000 (arange(10_000)) and array length 8194
category_specific_evidence: Round-trip mismatch: np.unravel_index followed by np.ravel_multi_index should reproduce the original flat indices, i.e. ravel_multi_index(unravel_index(i, shape), shape) == i.
Flat index 8192 -> expected (8, 192), returned (8, 192); flat index 8193 -> expected (8, 193), returned (8, 192); flat index 8194 -> expected (8, 194), returned (8, 192).
1-D input shape (8194,) gives returned coordinate 8 193 at position 8193, while 2-D input shape (8194, 1) with strides (8, 8) gives returned coordinate 8 192 and round-tripped value 8192.
Number of round-trip mismatches for 2-D input: 1 at first mismatch position 8193 (1 / 8194 elements, 0.0122%).
Regression test test_unravel_index_buffer_boundary uses indices = np.arange(10_000, dtype=np.intp)[:, None] with unravel_index to shape (100, 100) and asserts ravel_multi_index recovers indices.

Root cause per PR diff: buffered iterator specialization on a size-one inner axis with zero stride that RemoveMultiIndex may coalesce; fix sets op_stride to NPY_MAX_INTP when HASMULTIINDEX and NAD_SHAPE==1 and stride is 0.
Reviewer reported both added regression tests fail when the source patch is reverted on ARM Mac, and full test suite passes with the patch.
reproduction_risks: Reproduction depends on a NumPy version; the reproducer reports NumPy 2.3.4, and no other version is stated in the passages.
Mismatch appears only for the 2-D (N,1) input layout; the 1-D input at the same index returns the correct value, so both layouts must be tested together.
Platform-specific: reviewer confirmed failure on ARM Mac only; other platforms are not stated.
Failure occurs at a buffer-size boundary near index 8192-8193; reproduction should include indices in that range rather than only small values.
The passages do not give a numerical tolerance; the assertion is exact equality of integer coordinates.
